## EV charging CMS for CPOs and eMSPs

https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development
EV charging CMS for CPOs and eMSPs, built in Jaipur for India and worldwide. One charging management system covers CPO software (OCPP 1.6J and 2.0.1: onboarding, remote start/stop, tariffs, load management, alerts, settlement, GST invoice fields) and an eMSP platform (driver accounts, app/RFID tokens, OCPI 2.2.1 roaming, session authorisation, UPI, CDRs, support). The same CMS can run one role or both. Also covers driver apps, the operator dashboard, fleet charging, a white-label EV CMS, ISO 15118 readiness (not a live Plug & Charge claim), and analytics. The pricing page lists a starting range of ₹4,50,000 ex-GST for an MVP; this page does not treat that figure as a fixed package. PlugOne (https://plugone.in) is a live product. There is no separate IoT service page.

- CMS for CPO and eMSP — https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#cms-for-cpo-emsp
- CPO CMS — https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#cpo-cms
- eMSP platform — https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#emsp-cms
- CPMS / charging management system — https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#cpms
- OCPP 1.6J and 2.0.1 backend — https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#ocpp-backend
- OCPI 2.2.1 roaming — https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#ocpi-roaming
- OCPP vs OCPI — https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#ocpp-vs-ocpi
- eMSP and CPO platforms — https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#emsp-cpo
- Driver mobile app — https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#driver-app
- Operator dashboard — https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#operator-dashboard
- Smart charging — https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#smart-charging
- Hardware integration — https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#hardware-integration
- Billing and tariffs — https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#billing-tariffs
- Fleet charging — https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#fleet-charging
- White-label EV CMS — https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development#white-label
